policy.pass_alignment: Terra night turn assigned to the following solar date; all other turns keep their solar date
policy.selection: one family per suite by out-of-fold weekly MAE of the combined view; ties keep candidate order
policy.weights: inverse daily out-of-fold MAE on the common complete cohort
policy.extrapolation: input above the stratum training maximum flags the day and inflates its interval
policy.naive_baseline: uncalibrated native daily values with identical convex weights, alignment and cohort
